caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of a series of interlocking and attached brownish rings and bars. At the top, there is a semi-circular, smooth bar connected to two vertical bars, each with a large circular ring at its upper end. Below these are two smaller rings attached to each vertical bar, and these connect to a horizontal bar that forms a squared "U" shape. There is a joint at the bend of the "U" shape which attaches to a large, almost perfectly round ring at the bottom. The color scheme throughout the object is a uniform brown, and the texture appears metallic. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional elements. The artist's signature, "Gordeno Jackson," is visible in small text near the lower right.
title: Ring Bit
